cognitive_frame: topic product architecture shaping before any feature cycle is opened; frames every question as: is the topic-level product direction sound, are cross-feature capability boundaries visible, can downstream lulu-approach inherit product premises without re-deriving partitions — not whether a single feature's PRD or technical architecture is complete
information_nature: topic-level capability boundaries and value evolution spanning multiple future features
cross-cutting product constraints, exclusions, and invariants
product decisions and trade-off rationale at shaping granularity
assumptions that gate opening the next feature cycle
capability and journey views at milestone granularity
expression_conventions: analytical product prose — causal chains for SI are allowed; avoid technical architecture narrative, implementation register, or single-feature PRD detail; diagrams express capability partition, dependency, or cross-domain journey at topic level; tables express comparison or enumeration of product paths; all claims trace to decision-doc; no user-story backlogs, acceptance criteria matrices, or technical module specs
intent_anchor: all content must be traceable to the lulu-bet decision-doc SSOT; no intents beyond decision-doc scope; no enterprise-wide portfolio restructuring unless authorized there; downstream feature cycles inherit topic product structure from this document without guessing capability partitions
audience_type: product leads validating topic direction, stakeholders judging feature-cycle readiness, reviewers deciding whether shaping is complete — actionable at milestone granularity until feature decomposition begins
